title: Complex-level setup for pro-etale tensor-comparison descent
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism and let $R,S$ be commutative ring sheaves on the small pro-etale sites with an identification $f^{-1}R\simeq S$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $F=f_R^*$, $Q$ for localization to the unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $\mathcal P_R$ for the flat-term K-flat representative class [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model]. Then (1) $F$ preserves this class; (2) restriction along $(\mathcal P_R\to D(R))^2$ is fully faithful on functors with target $D(S)$; and (3) the specified ordinary signed-total comparison [def-sp-proetale-ordinary-tensor-pullback-total] forms a natural isomorphism $\operatorname{Tot}(FP\otimes_S FQ)\simeq F\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_R Q)$ on all complex pairs, whose inverse component at $(P,Q)$ is the inverse of the existing canonical total comparison. No derived tensor comparison is asserted in this setup lemma.

source.place: Tags 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product; 0G7E, lemma-pullback-K-flat; 04VK, localization universal property.

proof.text: Instantiate ringed-topos K-flat pullback with the normalized algebraic inverse image and identified scalar extension. Its module and map formulas are definitional, so it preserves K-flatness and site-flatness of the terms.

Resolve each homotopy object by a flat-term K-flat complex. Transport monoidal flatness to site-flatness with siteSheafTensorRightIso. Apply resolvingRepresentativesFullyFaithfulWhiskering and transfer along quotientCompQhIso.
Form NatIso.ofComponents from the existing total isomorphisms. Naturality on each tensor summand follows from inverse ordinary tensor naturality. The inverse component equation is definitional.

theorem proEtaleTensorPullbackDescentData :
    (∀ (P : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y R) ℤ),
      proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y R P →
        proEtaleFlatRepresentatives X S
          (((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ∧
    Nonempty (((whiskeringLeft
      ((proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y R).FullSubcategory ×
        (proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y R).FullSubcategory)
      (DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules Y R) ×
        DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules Y R))
      (DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X S))).obj
      (((proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y R).ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q).prod
        ((proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y R).ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q))).FullyFaithful) ∧
    ∃ e :
    ((((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
      ((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
      Functor.uncurry.obj ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor X S).map₂HomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ))) ≅
    (Functor.uncurry.obj ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor Y R).map₂HomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ))) ⋙
      (proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ),
    ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y R) ℤ,
      e.inv.app (P, Q) = (proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso f R S c P Q).inv
